# Actual MATLAB R2025b rational controls

Expected-only captures at Chebfun commit 7574c77. Provenance records the verified
full-source archive and byte digest for each original JSON artifact. Public
regressions fit independent functions; source coefficients are used only for
explicit arithmetic replay controls.

The primitive test covers 18 finite off-axis factors from 42 captured records.
Axis/zero factors, nonfinite divisors, general complex BLAS parity and private
helper differentiation are not qualified by those controls. Both public TYPE2
singleton cases keep separate handle checks and analytic p/q accuracy checks.
